mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.2% per annum indicates ultra-loose monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days when sustained for at least 3 months.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in FEDFUNDS < 0.2% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate increase exceeding 0.2 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending confidence, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in UNRATE increase > 0.2pp periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous quarterly GDP growth exceeding 2% annualized and industrial production growth above 0.1% in the prior month indicates robust economic expansion that supports equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth > 2% annualized and INDPRO growth > 0.1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in combined GDPC1/INDPRO growth periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY), sustained CPI increases signal central bank policy tightening that reduces equity risk appetite, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 900,000 units per month indicates strong consumer confidence in real estate, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days through immediate consumer spending effects.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in HOUST > 900,000 periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Monthly employment growth exceeding 0.5% signals robust job creation that increases disposable income and consumer spending, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in PAYEMS growth > 0.5% periods are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous retail sales growth exceeding 0.3% and federal funds rate below 0.2% indicates strong consumer demand combined with accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > 0.3% in 1 month and FEDFUNDS < 0.2%
regime_hint: strong demand and low interest rates
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in combined RSAFS/FEDFUNDS conditions are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production decline exceeding 0.3% signals economic contraction that triggers equity market sell-offs, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns in INDPRO decline > 0.3% periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
